description.value: The Roster is a locally owned sports bar and grill established in 1993, celebrated for its award-winning burgers and classic pub fare served amid walls of historic sports memorabilia. Attached to the bar is the only squash and racquetball facility in the North Okanagan, complemented by golf simulators and a range of other indoor sports. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a well-established Vernon gathering spot with multiple best-burger and restaurant-of-the-year accolades.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active pub and sports club at 2319 53 Ave Vernon, BC V1T 8K1, with phone 1-250-549-0444 found on the contact page. Takeout is explicitly offered via Skip the Dishes and an in-house take-out menu referenced across multiple pages; the menu also notes several 'Gluten-Friendly' items. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, WiFi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Rosters' but the website consistently refers to the business as 'The Roster Sports Club' and 'Rosters Sport Club Bar & Grill'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub and sports bar with a working website, confirmed physical address, and multiple recent local awards confirming ongoing operation.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels multiple items as 'Gluten-Friendly' (e.g., Classic Breakfast gluten-friendly without toast; Breakfast Poutine noted as Gluten-Friendly)

wow_evidence: locally owned sports bar and grill established in 1993
